- 音乐收藏可以直接在仪表盘里播放：支持 YouTube 视频和播放列表，以及网易云的单曲、歌单和播客。
  The music collection now plays inside the dashboard: YouTube videos and playlists, plus NetEase songs, playlists and podcasts.
- 新的悬浮播放器：可以拖动、最小化、切换大小，浏览别的页面时音乐不会停。
  New floating player: drag it, minimize it, switch its size; music keeps playing while you browse.
- 循环播放：整个收藏从上到下依次播放，或者从歌单、播客的任意一首开始往下播。因版权或 VIP 限制不能播放的歌会显示为灰色，并自动跳过。
  Loop playback for the whole collection, or a playlist or podcast from any track. Tracks blocked by licensing or VIP limits are greyed out and skipped.
- 网易云歌单现在会同步全部歌曲（最多 1000 首），不再只有前几首。
  NetEase playlists now sync every track (up to 1000), not just the first few.
- 可以删除收藏：右键卡片或在详情页点「删除」，笔记会移到废纸篓。
  Delete a collection item by right-clicking its card or from its detail page; the note moves to the trash.

QQ 音乐暂时没有可用的官方内嵌播放器，仍然在 QQ 音乐 App 中打开。
QQ Music has no working official embed yet, so it still opens in the QQ Music app.
